name: Huntington Beach (United States)
description: Navy blue field charged with the city emblem, a large yellow letter B and a panel of four scenes of the city — a sailboat and sun, a house and tree, an atom and a surfer — above the name Huntington Beach in yellow.
history: Huntington Beach is a city in Orange County, California. Flags of the World records this emblem flag as in use since 2012, replacing earlier flags of 2004–2005 and 2005–2011.
